aiRequirementCrosswalk.aiStatement: In Merchant Data Segment (Data Segment No. DL1), field 1 (Data Type Indicator) is required and must be present.
aiRequirementCrosswalk.assessment: The Test Solution now has positive marker presence and a negative omitted-marker case; its broader oracle rule also specifies the End-of-Data marker, so the AI BR maps to only part of that rule.

aiEvidenceByOracleRule.title: Segment DL1 maximum length is 399 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host)

Segment DL1 uses NO Field Separators; instead it is self-delimited by a Data Type Indicator ('#', field 1) and an End-of-Data Indicator ('~', last field) — a distinct delimiting convention from the numbered segments (85/84 Segment Type/Length pair)
Merchant Name(53,24), Store Number(98,16), Address Line 1(3,24), Address Line 2(4,21), Merchant Phone Number(54,13) are all required, Host-sourced fixed-length fields
Number of Card Types (Element 59) identifies how many times field 8 (Card Type) repeats — Card Type may repeat 01-99 times
A Card Type value of '173' in this segment's repeating Card Type field (Element 14) conditionally triggers Segment DL6 (Store and Forward) in the same Table Load Response
Segment DL1 fields are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the next field immediately follows (no empty-position placeholder is kept)
Segment DL1 is Required in the Table Load Response, carried as Data Block No. 1 immediately after the Start-of-Data Block Indicator (Element 97, fixed ')'), and is sent only on a Table Load Response

A Table Load takes place only when the merchant profile load flag is TABL; when the flag is not set, the Downline Load Response contains only an error message block and a terminating block, so Segment DL1 must be absent

Each repeated Card Type (Element 14) must be a valid Appendix E 'Card Type Code Used in the Table Load Response': an accepted card type or a device feature code (for example 127, 148, 150, 162-168, 171, 173, 174); feature codes are never used in Prompt Codes
Address Line 2 (Element 4, 21 characters) is positional: positions 1-12 city, 13 space, 14-15 alphabetic State Code (Appendix D), 16 space, 17-21 ZIP Code

Merchant Phone Number (Element 54) is 13 characters in the form (nnn)nnn-nnnn; Store Number (Element 98) is numeric in the range 0000000000000001-9999999999999999 and, when masked with asterisks, is neither displayed nor printed

Table Load Response block order is ')' + DL1, then DL2 (Conditional), then DL3 (Conditional), then End-of-Load Indicator '*' (Element 35); when DL1 carries Card Type 173, DL6 (Data Block No. 4) follows and the load ends with '*'. For TCP/IP the Start-of-Data Block Indicator appears only before Data Block No. 1
